title: check-skill-identifier-liveness: retiring an os generate kind reds the generate-kinds binding in both card orders
body:
domain:skills#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaqHXh17Qc3C7MRAQw

Filing gate: ① tooling defect with a named producer, raised as class b by the dev of PR #32546 (#32520, report 6814196068) and confirmed by contract review 6814405786 ③. ⛔ Not a claim; triage decides lane and grade.

## The binding

`scripts/check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs` Leg 2 binding `generate-kinds` (L408 on `main`): section `skills/objectstack-platform/references/operations.md` 「## Build & runtime」, members = `GENERATORS` **minus** `RETIRED_GENERATORS` (both in `packages/cli/src/commands/generate.ts`). It is the only binding with a `minus` set.

## Why no order works

Retiring a CLI generator kind under the split rule (product PR never edits `skills/**`, `lanes/skills.md` L13):

- Skills card first (row deleted while the kind is still live in `GENERATORS`): red `[leg2-missing-row]`.
- Retirement first (kind moved to `RETIRED_GENERATORS` while the row remains): red `[leg2-retired-row]`.

Both PRs are red whichever lands first, and the gate runs with no paths filter. This is outside the spec-property-retirement playbook (a CLI generator, not a spec property), so PR #32546 does not cover it.

## Reach

The next retirement of an `os generate` kind.

## Duplicate check

Searched open issues for `generate-kinds` and `RETIRED_GENERATORS`: only #32520. No open card.
